title_en: BARGAIN!! APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1+2 + PARKING POST ON NEW BULEVARD!
description_en: We have a 3+1+2 typology apartment in Gener 2, near the New Boulevard! The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchen, three bedrooms, two bathrooms, one of which has a laundry room, and two balconies. It is located on the 6th floor of a building under construction, in a highly sought-after area. Currently, the apartment is in the brick phase. Possibility of dividing into two apartments. Post parking included in the price. For information or a visit to the property, contact me.
